issues.description: Runtime acceptance criteria for fixture validation and scenario-id collision handling are covered mostly by source-text assertions rather than executable end-to-end tests.

sharedStateObservations.observation: This feature is mostly shell/YAML/test-harness plumbing, but it was assigned the Python-centric `testgrid-python` skill. The skill tells workers not to run the full `commands.test` set even though this feature explicitly required milestone-gate invocations, and the handoff shows the worker verified only plain `pytest` while claiming the milestone gates passed.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json:1181-1182 assigns `skillName: testgrid-python`; SKILL.md:3 describes the skill as editing the testgrid Python package and SKILL.md:43-53 says to run only worker-scoped UV commands and 'DO NOT run the full `commands.test` set'; handoff file:11-24 claims milestone gates passed but records only `uv run --directory engine/testgrid pytest`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission guidance says scenario YAMLs require a document-start marker, but the repo-wide yamllint config now disables that rule. The written convention and the enforced lint policy disagree.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: mission AGENTS.md:86-89 says scenario YAMLs require `---`; `.yamllint`:13-14 disables `document-start`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission library guidance for the schema sweep is stale. The feature metadata and implementation moved the repo to `check-jsonschema`, but the shared library still tells validators to use `jsonschema`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json:1187 says `check-jsonschema` is the preferred replacement; library/environment.md:28 and library/user-testing.md:23,50 still direct validators to `jsonschema`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature introduced `sweep-scenarios.sh` and `orphan-audit.sh` as first-class validation tools, but `services.yaml` still exposes only install/build/test/typecheck/lint commands. Validators have to rediscover these scripts ad hoc instead of consuming them from shared state.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff file:11-12 lists `sweep-scenarios.sh` and `orphan-audit.sh` among the core F1.5 outputs; services.yaml:1-8 defines no command aliases for either script.

evidence.detail: F1.5 explicitly requires the milestone `commands.test`, `commands.typecheck`, and `commands.lint` contract to pass.
The shared test command still invokes `uv run --directory /Users/rohit/Documents/chart-test-swarm/engine/testgrid pytest -n 2` after the bats suites.
The current working tree now adds `pytest-xdist>=3.6` to the dev dependency group.
The current lockfile now includes `execnet` and `pytest-xdist`, and wires `pytest-xdist` into the dev dependency metadata, so a clean `uv sync` can satisfy `pytest -n 2`.

The original worker handoff claimed milestone gates passed but recorded only plain `uv run --directory engine/testgrid pytest`, which explains how the missing-`xdist` gap slipped through the original review.
The remaining regression-coverage gap is visible in the source-text assertions for fixture-validation and scenario-collision behavior.
